summary: Radware Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting its second quarter 2026 financial results on July 29, 2026. The filing includes record revenue of $82.3 million (up 11% YoY), Cloud ARR of $103 million, non-GAAP diluted EPS of $0.30, and GAAP diluted EPS of $0.09. No special-situation event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrupt management change—is disclosed. This is solely an ordinary earnings release.
